output.summary: Evergreen shrub or small tree native to southern Europe, North Africa, Western Asia, Macaronesia and the Indian subcontinent. Its leaves contain fragrant oil, while its white or pink-tinged flowers develop into edible blue-black berries that are also macerated in alcohol for Mirto liqueur.
output.edibilityNote: Ripe blue-black berries are edible and are also macerated in alcohol to make Mirto liqueur.
